name: Michael Chemaly
bio: Michael Chemaly is a Los Angeles-based commercial director specializing in comedy, sports performance, and dynamic brand storytelling. Known for his sharp comedic timing and high-energy visual rhythm, he has built a reputation for directing marquee athletes and non-actors consistently pulling natural, deadpan, and charismatic performances out of talent within high-stakes, rapid-turnaround windows. His commercial work spans major broadcast and digital campaigns directing icons including Mike Trout, Ken Griffey Jr., Bryce Harper, Clayton Kershaw, and Paul Skenes, as well as cult-classic talent like Patrick Renna. Combining technical precision with an instinct for comedic rapport, Michael combines tight technical execution with a relaxed set demeanor, empowering elite talent to deliver on limited clocks.
